data.one_liner: Flutter widget that renders text along an arc with configurable radius.
data.what_it_does: Provides an ArcText widget that draws text along a curved path. Supports configurations for radius, text styles, start angles, alignment, placement, and direction.
use_when: You need to render curved or circular text in your UI
You want a customizable widget for text along an arc without writing custom painting code
avoid_when: You need complex text layouts that are not circular or curved
You require advanced text effects unrelated to arc paths
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific visual task (rendering text along an arc)
